2608.14028.title: AdvDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Joint-Aligned Actions and Adversarial Learning
2608.14028.paper_summary: Dexterous manipulation is a fundamental capability for embodied intelligence, but scaling it remains difficult because robot demonstrations are expensive to collect and action spaces vary across embodiments. Policies trained on heterogeneous data can also entangle task-relevant visual cues with embodiment-specific appearance, limiting cross-embodiment generalization. We present AdvDex, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework for learning dexterous manipulation from human and robot demonstrations. First, we introduce OmniShare, a large-scale multimodal dataset of human manipulation demonstrations that provides high-quality kinematic supervision and tactile measurements while reducing reliance on robot teleoperation. Second, we propose the Joint-Aligned Action Space (JAAS), a canonical action representation comprising an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ wrist pose and 15 finger joints, thereby functionally aligning human hands, dexterous robot hands, and parallel grippers. Finally, we use domain-adversarial learning to reduce embodiment-specific information in the learned visual representation. Experiments on hand-action prediction and real-world dexterous manipulation show consistent improvements over baselines, effective zero-shot human-to-robot skill transfer, generalization to unseen objects and environments, and data-efficient few-shot adaptation.
2608.14028.paper_summary_zh: 靈巧操作是具身智能的一項基本能力，但由於機器人示範收集成本高昂且行動空間在不同實體之間變化，擴展這一能力仍然困難。基於異質數據訓練的策略也可能將與任務相關的視覺線索與特定於實體的外觀糾纏在一起，限制了跨實體的泛化。我們提出了AdvDex，這是一個統一的視覺-語言-行動框架，用於從人類和機器人示範中學習靈巧操作。首先，我們介紹了OmniShare，一個大規模的多模態數據集，包含人類操作示範，提供高質量的運動學監督和觸覺測量，同時減少對機器人遙控操作的依賴。其次，我們提出了聯合對齊行動空間（JAAS），這是一種典型的行動表示，包含一個$\mathrm{SE}(3)$手腕姿勢和15個手指關節，從而在功能上對齊人類手、靈巧機器人手和並行夾具。最後，我們使用領域對抗學習來減少學習到的視覺表示中的特定於實體的信息。在手部動作預測和現實世界靈巧操作的實驗中，顯示出相對於基線的一致改善、有效的零樣本人機技能轉移、對未見物體和環境的泛化，以及數據高效的少量樣本適應。
